name: Solana Portfolio
short_description: Track your crypto wealth across Solana wallets
long_description:
A privacy-focused portfolio tracker for Solana. Track multiple wallets, view token holdings, DeFi positions (Kamino, Marginfi, Drift, etc.), and historical portfolio growth.

Features:
• Track unlimited wallets
• View token balances and values
• See DeFi deposits, borrows, and rewards
• Portfolio growth charts
• Create portfolio groups/labels
• No sign-up required
• Privacy-first: no tracking or data collection

Pro features:
• Track multiple personal wallets
• Portfolio snapshots and historical tracking
• Priority support

solana_mobile_dapp_publisher_portal.testing_instructions:
1. Open app
2. Enter any Solana wallet address
3. View portfolio data
4. (Optional) Connect wallet to access Pro features
